quests.title: Finches Are Still the Cutest

dialogue.t: Chirp chirp! Coo coo! Chirp chirp chirp!

dialogue.sit: Are you sending... some kind of secret message?
Or speaking in some kind of... code?

dialogue.t: Sort of! This is a technique I use to communicate with the cute little finches.
Oh, I seem to have forgotten to say hello to you folks. And the all-important opening line.
Kind Travelers passing through, I, Basima the Fifth, Amurta researcher, rising mercantile star, and expert on adorable animals, offer my heartfelt greetings.
Please. Relax thy body, clear thy mind, and listen closely, for I have a matter of utmost importance to share with you—
You're absolutely correct! Congratulations, looks like the Finch's cuteness got to you too. You're even jumping to answer right away!
This is odd. Paimon's not sure why, but when she saw the game on the table, this line just popped into her head.
Does this feel familiar to you too, {NICKNAME}?

dialogue.sit: We've met this lady before, right?
We can start the "finches are the cutest" thing now, if you want.

dialogue.t: You're right! And it wasn't just a brief encounter either. It warms my heart to see you both still so full of life!
Anyway, would you like to try this game? This is version 17 from the third generation of "Bing-Bang Finchball!"
As you unwind and enjoy the game, you'll also get to hear wonderful stories of how the little finch, alongside the much, much bigger Ancient Scarlet-Plume Finch, triumphed over the gulls!
Sounds awesome! We've always been huge fans of relaxing games!
Alright! I hope you find the way of playing that suits you best and enjoy a one-of-a-kind experience!

quests.description: Somewhere in Atocpan, you and Paimon run into a cheerful researcher slash merchant slash expert on adorable creatures. She invites you to play a game…
